analysis.executive_summary: Liveblocks documentation audit covered 786 pages with 100% crawl coverage and 83.72% overall confidence. The site contains 29 confirmed broken internal links, all within user-facing documentation. API reference coverage is low at 33.33% across 76 detected API pages. Only 40.41% of pages display last-updated metadata, limiting freshness transparency. Example code reliability estimate stands at 79.72%.
strengths: Complete crawl coverage at 100% (786 of 786 pages in scope)
No repository navigation link breakage (0 repo_broken_links)
Single-product topology provides clear documentation structure
API pages successfully detected (76 pages, no detection limitations flagged)
risks: 29 confirmed broken internal links in user-facing documentation degrade navigation and user trust
API reference coverage at 33.33% leaves two-thirds of API surface undocumented or poorly linked
7 unverified links due to auth/rate-limit/server blocks create uncertainty in link health
Only 40.41% freshness coverage prevents users from assessing content currency
Example reliability at 79.72% means approximately 1 in 5 code samples may be outdated or broken
Link verification confidence at 75.56% is lowest among audit dimensions
SEO/geo issue rate at 0.54% may impact discoverability in certain markets

prioritized_actions.action: Fix all 29 confirmed broken internal documentation links
Expand API reference coverage from 33.33% to minimum 80% by documenting missing endpoints and improving interlinking
Implement last-updated timestamps on all pages to increase freshness coverage from 40.41% to 95%+
Audit and update code examples to improve reliability from 79.72% to 90%+ through automated testing
Investigate and resolve 7 unverified links blocked by auth/rate-limits to eliminate verification gaps

limitations: External audit cannot verify content accuracy, only structural and link integrity
7 links remain unverified due to authentication or rate-limiting; actual breakage unknown
API coverage measurement depends on detection heuristics; actual coverage may vary if non-standard page structures exist
Example reliability is estimated through static analysis; runtime execution success not guaranteed
Audit cannot assess documentation completeness, clarity, or alignment with actual product behavior
